overview.description: The VegaShares AI Thermal, Cooling & Power Management ETF (COOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of companies involved in the power and thermal infrastructure required by high-density AI data centers, using the BITA AI Thermal, Cooling & Power Management Global Index as its primary portfolio-construction baseline. The fund may invest globally across all market caps COOL was launched on Aug 13, 2026 and is issued by Vegashares.

data.title: VegaShares Announces Launch of the AI Inference ETF (CGPT) and the AI Thermal, Cooling & Power Management ETF (COOL)
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $CGPT #AI--VegaShares announces launch of two AI thematic ETFs -- AI Inference ETF (ticker: CGPT) and AI Thermal, Cooling & Power Management ETF (ticker: COOL).
